description: Set up Vite project structure, install dependencies, create src/ directory layout, configure TanStack Router, vite-plugin-pwa, and Tailwind. Remove Next.js dependencies and config files.
steps: Remove Next.js-specific dependencies from package.json: next, next-pwa, next-themes, eslint-config-next. Remove scripts that reference next commands.

Install new dependencies: vite, @vitejs/plugin-react, vite-plugin-pwa, @tanstack/react-router, @tanstack/router-devtools (dev). Keep all existing deps: @tanstack/react-query, convex, react, react-dom, all radix-ui packages, tailwind, etc.

Create vite.config.ts at root with: @vitejs/plugin-react, vite-plugin-pwa configured with the manifest from manifest.json (name: River Water Level, short_name: RWL, theme_color: #317EFB, icons, etc.), and path alias @ -> ./src.
Create src/ directory structure: src/routes/, src/components/, src/hooks/, src/lib/, src/styles/, src/utils/

Create index.html at root (Vite entry point) with proper meta tags from _document.tsx (viewport, PWA meta, apple-touch-icon, theme-color, etc.). Include
and .
Create src/main.tsx as the app entry point: renders React root with RouterProvider from TanStack Router.

Create src/routeTree.gen.ts placeholder and src/routes/__root.tsx as the root route layout. The root route should contain the QueryClientProvider, ThemeProvider (use a simple class-based theme toggle instead of next-themes), FilterProvider, Layout component, and the Outlet for child routes.
Create src/routes/index.tsx that redirects to /stations (replicating the Next.js redirect in next.config.mjs).

Create src/routes/stations/index.tsx - move the StationsPage component from pages/stations/index.tsx, removing Next.js imports (Head, useRouter, getStaticProps). Use TanStack Router's useNavigate and Link instead of next/router.

Create src/routes/stations/$id.tsx - move the StationDetail component from pages/stations/[id].tsx, replacing useRouter().query with TanStack Router's useParams. Replace next/image with a standard tag. Replace next/head with document.title updates or a helmet equivalent.
Create src/routes/cameras/index.tsx - move the CamerasPage from pages/cameras/index.tsx, removing Next.js imports.

Move all files from components/ to src/components/, hooks/ to src/hooks/, lib/ to src/lib/, utils/ to src/utils/, styles/ to src/styles/. Update the convexClient.ts to use import.meta.env.VITE_CONVEX_URL instead of process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL.

Update the Layout component (src/components/layout.tsx) to use TanStack Router's useNavigate/useLocation instead of next/router. Replace next-themes useTheme with a simple React context for theme toggling (add/remove 'dark' class on documentElement).
Update BottomNavigation.tsx to work without next/router.
Update tailwind.config.ts content paths to use src/**/*.{ts,tsx} instead of pages/**.
Update tsconfig.json: remove next-env.d.ts from include, update paths alias to @/* -> [./src/*], set jsx to react-jsx, add vite-env.d.ts reference.
Create src/vite-env.d.ts with /// <reference types='vite/client' /> and interface for ImportMetaEnv with VITE_CONVEX_URL.
Update postcss.config.mjs (keep as-is, compatible with Vite).
Update package.json scripts: dev -> vite, build -> tsc && vite build, preview -> vite preview.
Update netlify.toml: change publish to 'dist', remove @netlify/plugin-nextjs plugin, remove edge_functions, add SPA redirect rule [[redirects]] from = '/*' to = '/index.html' status = 200.
Remove files no longer needed: next.config.mjs, next-env.d.ts, pages/ directory (after content is migrated to src/routes/), components.json shadcn config (update baseUrl to src/).

Create a Netlify function (netlify/functions/proxy-image.ts) to replace the Next.js API route for /api/proxy-image/[id]. This fetches camera images from the JPS server and returns them. Add a redirect in netlify.toml: /api/proxy-image/:id -> /.netlify/functions/proxy-image?id=:id.
Run npm install and npm run build to verify everything compiles.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes without errors producing a dist/ directory
No imports from 'next', 'next/router', 'next/head', 'next/image', 'next-pwa', 'next-themes' remain in src/
TanStack Router is properly configured with file-based or manual route tree
vite-plugin-pwa is configured with correct manifest and generates service worker
Tailwind CSS processes correctly with Vite
netlify.toml is configured for static SPA deployment with dist/ as publish directory
verification: Run 'npm run build' and confirm it exits with code 0 and creates dist/ directory
Run 'grep -r "from .next" src/' and confirm no matches (no Next.js imports)
Check dist/index.html exists and contains the root div
findings: Build produces a single 647KB JS chunk (warning from Vite about chunks > 500KB). The chunk size warning can be addressed later via code-splitting with dynamic imports. The convex/_generated directory remains at root (not moved to src/) since it is auto-generated by the Convex CLI. All hooks reference it with relative paths from src/hooks/ (../../convex/_generated/). The pages/api/stations/[stationId].ts (OG data endpoint) was removed - it was only needed for server-side rendering. The netlify/edge-functions/og-image.tsx remains untouched as it is a separate concern. vite-plugin-pwa generates sw.js and workbox files in dist/ so the old public/sw.js and public/workbox files were removed.
